expected_labels.S0101_C03_033E: Estimate!!Male!!Total population!!SUMMARY INDICATORS!!Sex ratio (males per 100 females)

selection_rationale: Fixed feasibility frame: age counts for numeric/zero controls, overall and Asian-alone median income for non-computability/interval qualifications, and an age/sex subject table for structural non-applicability. Purposive selection, not ACS prevalence estimation. Version 2 corrects the subject-table variable using acquired 2023 metadata: C02_031 is percent aged 75+, whereas C03_033 is the male-column sex ratio. No observations were acquired before either version. Actual annotation remains unverified.
exclusions: Margins of error, comparison significance, unrecognized or inconsistent estimate/annotation pairs. No silent exclusion: unknown pairs block readiness.
readiness_scope: Thresholds justify only preparing a pilot, not statistical power or paper promotion. Natural rendering, manual parser audit, and a model protocol remain required.
